description.value: Living Tree Foods is a plant-based food producer with a retail storefront in New Westminster, BC, founded in 2020 by two UBC Law graduates. The company specializes in 100% vegan, clean-ingredient dairy alternatives including cashew cream cheese spreads and plant-based ravioli, with no artificial fillers or additives. Products are sold at the Royal Avenue store, at farmers' markets across Metro Vancouver and Squamish, and at select grocers including Whole Foods, Safeway, Thrifty Foods, and IGA.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website FAQ explicitly confirms a physical storefront ('Our brick and mortar store at 1025 Royal Ave in New Westminster'), corroborating the OSM address but contradicting the OSM community field of 'Vancouver.' All products are confirmed 100% vegan via the FAQ ('YES! Our products are, and will always be, 100% vegan'). No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
